grammar.summary: 本课学习表"纪念碑"的被动叙事与 take shape。

points.title: 被动叙事（建造历程）
points.explanation: The statue was made / was taken to pieces / was put together again. 被动串起"制作-运输-重建"全过程。

examples.en: The statue was made in Paris.

points.title: take shape 表成形
points.explanation: The great statue began to take shape. 字面"获得形状"引申为"初具轮廓"。

examples.en: It was officially presented to the American people.
examples.cn: 它被正式赠送给美国人民。
